violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. No CFM present at the inspection.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. EHS will follow up to ensure a CFM is present.

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. No CFM present at the beginning of the inspection.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. CFM arrived during the inspection.

violations.title: Segregate Damaged, Spoiled, Recalled Foods
violations.observation: Damaged, spoiled or recalled food stored in a location that does not segregate the product. Cucumbers with mold growth observed on shelf in walk in cooler.
violations.corrective_action: Damaged, spoiled, or recalled food shall be held in the food establishment as stated under 6-404.11. Do NOT store damaged, spoiled, or recalled food with food that is going to be used for the consumer. PIC discarded cucumbers.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: sliced cheese (53F), steak (49F), sliced ham (47F), sliced turkey (47F), and chicken (48F) observed in cold service table right.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. TCS food items discarded from unit.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: COLD SERVING TABLE RIGHT OBSERVED AT 46F.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. TCS FOOD ITEMS REMOVED FROM UNIT.
